newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter sees layoffs in equity unit - sources.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter sees layoffs in equity unit - sources.

text.p: Layoffs are likely at Dean Witter's equity sales, trading desk and in equity research, according to several Dean Witter sources.
The layoffs would come as parent Dean Witter Discover & Co and Morgan Stanley Group Inc prepare to combine.
The two firms announced the mega-merger deal on Wednesday.
A Dean Witter spokesman had no immediate comment.

Dean Witter sources said equity traders and the institutional sales force were, in a meeting Thursday, told by Bob Sculthorpe, executive vice president of the equity division, there would likely be layoffs in the department, with not all employees likely to fit in the combination.
No details were given at the meeting.
Sculthorpe was not immediately available for comment.
The sources said traders and salesmen would probably to be informed next week of layoffs.
The source said that a similar meeting was held on Wednesday for equity research analysts.
Senior Dean Witter and Morgan Stanley executives were meeting Friday to map out details of what personnel they would need, the sources said.
One employee in the Dean Witter equity unit said workers were expecting to remain at the firm for about six months until the deal was seen closing, but workers there expected widespread layoffs.
